reason: App and Tauri web-shell development checklist.
Shared UI placement, NativeWind tokens, accessibility and theme rules.
Data ownership, mutation outcomes, route lifecycle and sub-minute clock exception.
Database remains authoritative; avoid duplicate rows and per-second Context updates.
Cross-package boundaries and shared Expo frontend for Tauri.
Typed errors, logging, exports and injected timestamps.
Full web gate, browser evidence and CI-only installer packaging.
One owner for typed IPC decoding and source identity.
Reuse focus timer and UI primitives; avoid new state/event frameworks.
Existing flows, entry points and state defects that extraction must preserve or correct.
Pinned Tauri APIs, custom-command security and background-window limits.
